entry.summary: 《Pectra 升级后的以太坊 Blob 市场现状》2025 年 5 月 7 日以太坊 Pectra 升级上线，将每个区块的目标和最大 blob 数分别提升为 6 和 9，使 blob 数据容量每天达约 8.15GB。升级后 rollup 每日购买 blob 数量增加 20.8%，但平均使用量仅为新目标值的三分之二，导致 blob 成本骤降近 100%，每日费用不足千分之一美分，ETH 烧毁量下降 71%。同时，节点需存储的未修剪数据量达 44.6GB 的历史新高，若需求达目标率或需存储 95-100GB。尽管 rollup 利润率提升，Base 等项目净收入增长，但部分主流 rollup 交易成本未降反升，且节点数据存储压力显著增加。阅读全文：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/TczF1P9unJRniAPq9-ydng

And if these frameworks are already exploited by cartels, can you outline precisely how imposing these same AML/CFT regulations on "unhosted wallets" would stop cartels from exploiting them – and not just impose unproportionate burdens on the average user? Given what Elliptic has outlined in their newest report, lawmakers should be extremely wary of relying on for-profit marketing materials to inform their decisions, and keep in mind that the expansion of AML/CFT frameworks to "unhosted wallets" would drastically enlarge such firms' addressable market, constituting a clear profit motive – while likely doing nothing to stop actual crime.
